strength.text: Lux lists heat-pump air conditioning, a 360-degree camera and a space-saver spare.

tradeoff.label: Cabin adjustment

Australian ORA 5 SUV; brochure information current 11 June 2026, edition GWMA 20260611; manufacturer MY unverified

435 km is WLTC, after a full charge, for comparison only with vehicles tested to the same procedures. Real range varies with battery age/condition, driving style, heating/cooling, traffic, weather, accessories and load. It is not WLTP.
58.33 kWh is the manufacturer-stated capacity label; gross and usable capacity are not established.

10–80% in 30 minutes uses a 120 kW DC charger; 30–80% in 20 minutes is a separate window. The explicit charging-condition footnote belongs to the latter claim. Charger rating does not establish vehicle DC peak. The unusual AC 0–100% in 6.6 hours at 6.6 kW claim is preserved without recalculation or real-use verification.

Observed driveaway-from advertisement for private buyers in Victoria on 10 October 2026 only; no final quote or unconditional national price. The generic offers footer still refers to 2026 builds and 30 September 2026; it cannot establish MY, build applicability or October price validity.
June-2026 manufacturer matrix applies to this named SUV grade; specifications and equipment may change, and individual vehicle fitment needs confirmation.

Vehicle cover is qualified by use and first sale through an authorised Australian dealer. Current webpage paying-passenger wording differs from broader commercial wording in linked ©2024 terms. ORA power-battery commercial mileage and SOH exclusions remain; no unconditional retention replacement guarantee is established.
Cargo method and towing brake condition remain unknown; no active SOS claim follows from the September ETA.
